text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following strict instructions. Going further, deep learning uses complex networks inspired by the human brain to handle even harder tasks, like recognizing faces or translating languages. You already use AI every day. When your phone predicts your next word, a streaming service suggests a movie, or a navigation app finds the fastest route, AI is at work behind the scenes.
